PDFPUNDiT — ANSI BBS mockups

112×38 cells, truecolor. Theme: DarkBerry Blackwater (default; the Mire, Fen and Wisp flavours and a few others are in the theme chooser). The main way in is dropping PDFs on the cat's face: it opens its mouth when a file hovers over it, eats it, and the batch repairs itself. It only asks you something when a decision really needs a human. Generated by pdfpundit-ansi-bbs/generate.py; see the README beside it.

Frame 1 — idle. The cat is the drop target; menus and history sit to the side.
